author: The Current
description:
Khruangbin perform "Little Joe and Mary" live in studio
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Ten years ago, the Houston-based band Khruangbin gathered in a barn in rural Texas to record what became their debut album, "The Universe Smiles Upon You." A decade later, the band members reconvened in that same barn to revisit that music — sessions that resulted in a 10th-anniversary “revisited” edition of the album, which Khruangbin have dubbed "The Universe Smiles Upon You ii."

While on tour in support of the revisited album, Khruangbin were in the Twin Cities to play at First Avenue in Minneapolis. Before the show, they stopped at The Current to play selections from The Universe Smiles Upon You ii, creating a sound that The Current’s Jill Riley has described as “space twang.” Watch a performance of "Little Joe and Mary" above.

Musicians
Laura Lee – bass, vocals
Mark Speer – guitar, vocals
Donald DJ Johnson – drums, keys, vocals
Will Van Horn – p

Khruangbin describe their connection to musician Will Van Horn

During an interview with Jill Riley at The Current, the members of Khruangbin talk their decision to bring their frequent collaborator, musician Will Van Horn, with them on tour for "The Universe Smiles Upon You ii."

Khruangbin's 2025 release, "The Universe Smiles Upon You ii," is available on @deadoceansrecs.
